blocks.text: Farq qanchalik katta? much, a bit, any, no

Qiyosiy darajaning o'zi faqat «farq bor» deydi: cheaper — arzonroq. Lekin real nutqda farqning **o'lchami** ham muhim: «**ancha** arzon», «**sal** arzonroq», «**sira** arzon emas», «**tobora** arzonlashyapti». Qizil kitobda much / a lot / a bit bilan tanishgansiz (→ qizil kitob, 88-dars), qiyosiy shakllarning yasalishi esa 105-darsda. Bu darsda — to'liq tizim: farqni kuchaytiruvchi va yumshatuvchi so'zlar, ot bilan **much more / many more**, savol va inkorda **any / no** + qiyosiy, **better and better** va **the more ..., the more ...** qolipi.

Nozik farqlar: **far** — eng kuchli va biroz rasmiyroq, yozuvda ko'p uchraydi; **a lot** — so'zlashuvda; **slightly** — «biroz», rasmiy va neytral. **very** qiyosiy daraja oldida ishlatilmaydi: «very better» emas — **much better**. O'zbekchada «juda» va «ancha» ba'zan aralashib ketadi, lekin inglizchada qoida qat'iy: **very** — oddiy sifat bilan (very cheap), **much / far** — qiyosiy bilan (much cheaper). Quantifier sifatida **much** darak gapda kam ishlatiladi (→ 87-dars), lekin qiyosiy daraja oldida bemalol: It's **much** colder today.

items.text: The flat in the centre is **far more expensive**, but it's close to everything.
items.translation: Markazdagi kvartira **ancha qimmat**, lekin hamma narsaga yaqin.

items.text: Could you come **a little earlier** tomorrow? We have a lot to do.
items.translation: Ertaga **sal ertaroq** kela olasizmi? Ishimiz ko'p.

items.text: Unemployment is **significantly lower** than it was five years ago.
items.translation: Ishsizlik besh yil oldingiga qaraganda **sezilarli darajada past**.

blocks.text: Ot bilan: much more time, many more people

**more** dan keyin ot kelsa, kuchaytiruvchi so'z otga moslashadi: **much more** + sanalmaydigan ot (much more time, much more money), **many more** + sanaladigan ko'plik ot (many more people, many more problems). **a lot more** va **far more** ikkalasi bilan ham ishlaydi. Kichik farq uchun: **a little more / a bit more** + sanalmaydigan, **a few more** + ko'plik ot. Teskari tomonda ham shu mantiq: **much less** / **far less** time, **far fewer** cars. O'zbekchada hammasi «ancha ko'p», shuning uchun «much more people» deb xato qilish oson.

rows: **a little more** time, **a bit more** money
**a few more** people, **a couple more** cars

items.text: We need **many more** volunteers for the festival.
items.translation: Festival uchun bizga **ancha ko'p** ko'ngilli kerak.

items.text: Children today spend **much more** time online than outside.
items.translation: Bugungi bolalar tashqaridan ko'ra internetda **ancha ko'p** vaqt o'tkazadi.

items.text: Can you wait **a few more** minutes? I'm almost ready.
items.translation: Yana **bir necha** daqiqa kuta olasizmi? Deyarli tayyorman.

blocks.text: any better? no better — savol va inkorda

Savol va inkorda qiyosiy daraja oldiga **any** qo'yiladi: Is your knee **any better**? — Tizzangiz sal tuzukmi? I can't walk **any further** — Bundan nariga yura olmayman. **any** bu yerda «hech, sira, ozgina bo'lsa ham» degan ma'no beradi. **no** + qiyosiy = **not any** + qiyosiy: The new model is **no faster** = isn't **any faster** — sira tezroq emas. **no** ... **than** ko'pincha hafsalasi pir bo'lganini bildiradi: The hotel was **no better than** a hostel — mehmonxona yotoqxonadan yaxshi emasdi. Ikki inkor qo'shilmaydi: «I can't walk no further» — xato.

rows: My salary is **no higher than** last year.

items.text: Has the weather got **any warmer** in Tashkent this week?
This printer is **no faster** than the old one, and it cost twice as much.
items.translation: Bu printer eskisidan **sira tez emas**, ustiga-ustak ikki baravar qimmat turdi.

items.text: If you don't feel **any better** tomorrow, stay at home.
items.translation: Ertaga o'zingizni **sal ham yaxshi** his qilmasangiz, uyda qoling.

blocks.text: Uzluksiz o'zgarishni ko'rsatish uchun qiyosiy daraja **and** bilan takrorlanadi: **better and better**, **worse and worse**, **bigger and bigger**, **longer and longer**. Uzun sifatlarda **more** takrorlanadi, sifat esa bir marta keladi: **more and more expensive** («more expensive and more expensive» emas). Ot bilan: **more and more people**, kamayish uchun: **less and less**. Bu qolip ko'pincha **get / become / grow** fe'llari va Continuous zamonlar bilan keladi (→ 1-dars). O'zbekchada: «**tobora**», «**borgan sari**», «**kundan kunga**».

items.text: The city is getting **bigger and bigger** every year.
Mobile data is becoming **more and more expensive**.
I'm going to the gym **less and less** because of work.
items.translation: Ish tufayli sport zaliga **tobora kamroq** boryapman.

blocks.text: the more ..., the more ... — qanchalik ..., shunchalik ...

Ikki o'zgarish bir-biriga bog'liq bo'lsa: **the** + qiyosiy ..., **the** + qiyosiy .... Birinchi qism — sabab yoki shart, ikkinchisi — natija. Har ikki qism **the** bilan boshlanadi, qiyosiy so'z oldinga chiqadi, ega va fe'l undan keyin keladi: **The older** I get, **the less** I sleep. Ot bilan: **The more money** you earn, **the more tax** you pay. Qisqa, fe'lsiz shakllar so'zlashuvda juda ko'p: **The sooner, the better**. **The bigger, the better**. **The more, the merrier** (qancha ko'p bo'lsak, shuncha qiziq). O'zbekchada: «qanchalik ...-sa, shunchalik ...», «...-gan sari ...».

rows: Qanchalik ko'p mashq qilsangiz, shunchalik yaxshi bo'lasiz.
U qancha ko'p pul topsa, shuncha ko'p sarflaydi.

items.text: **The more** I listen to this song, **the more** I like it.
items.translation: Bu qo'shiqni **qancha ko'p** eshitsam, **shuncha ko'proq** yoqadi.

items.text: **The sooner** we leave, **the sooner** we'll get there.
**The bigger** the city, **the higher** the rents.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «very better» → **much better**; «much more people» → **many more** people; «more and more better» → **better and better**; «more expensive and more expensive» → **more and more expensive**; «The more you read, more you learn» → **the more** you learn (ikkinchi the tushib qolmasin); «The more you study, you get better» → **the better** you get (qiyosiy so'z oldinga chiqadi); «Is it any more better?» → Is it **any better**?; «I can't walk no further» → I can't walk **any further**.

O'zbekcha so'zdan inglizchaga: «ancha» → **much / far / a lot**; «sal, biroz» → **a bit / a little / slightly**; «sira, hech» (savol va inkorda) → **any / no**; «tobora» → **X and X** (better and better); «qanchalik ..., shunchalik ...» → **the ..., the ...**.

Bog'lanish: qiyosiy shakllarning yasalishi (busier, more careful, further, less / fewer) — 105-dars; as ... as, twice as ... as, than me — 107-dars; **even** + qiyosiy (even better) — 112-dars; **no longer** / **not any more** — 111-dars.

rows: X **and** X / **more and more** + uzun sifat

examples.title: Big differences: **much**, **far**, **a lot** + comparative
examples.description: Katta farq: **much**, **far**, **a lot** qiyosiy daraja oldida — o'zbekchadagi «ancha».

sentences.text: The new airport terminal is **much bigger** than the old one.
sentences.translation: Aeroportning yangi terminali eskisidan **ancha katta**.

sentences.text: Living in London is **far more expensive** than living in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Londonda yashash Manchesterda yashashdan **ancha qimmat**.

sentences.text: After the operation, Dilnoza felt **a lot better** within a week.
sentences.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin bir hafta ichida Dilnoza o'zini **ancha yaxshi** his qildi.

sentences.text: Online courses are often **much cheaper** than evening classes.
sentences.translation: Onlayn kurslar ko'pincha kechki mashg'ulotlardan **ancha arzon**.

sentences.text: My new phone charges **far more quickly** than my old one did.
sentences.translation: Yangi telefonim eskisiga qaraganda **ancha tez** quvvatlanadi.

sentences.text: Is the road to Samarkand **much better** now that it's been rebuilt?
sentences.translation: Samarqand yo'li qayta qurilgach, **ancha yaxshi** bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: Tom earns **a lot more** than me, but he works longer hours.
sentences.translation: Tom mendan **ancha ko'p** pul topadi, lekin ko'proq soat ishlaydi.

sentences.text: This year's exams were **far harder** than we had expected.
sentences.translation: Bu yilgi imtihonlar biz kutganimizdan **ancha qiyin** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Cycling to work is **much healthier** than sitting in a traffic jam.
sentences.translation: Ishga velosipedda borish tirbandlikda o'tirishdan **ancha foydali**.

sentences.text: Since she moved to Oxford, Kate has been **a lot happier** and **much less stressed**.
sentences.translation: Oksfordga ko'chib o'tganidan beri Keyt **ancha baxtli** va **ancha xotirjam**.

sentences.text: Could we meet **a bit later**? My lecture finishes at five.
sentences.translation: **Sal kechroq** uchrashsak bo'ladimi? Ma'ruzam beshda tugaydi.

sentences.text: The blue jacket is **slightly more expensive**, but the quality is better.
sentences.translation: Ko'k kurtka **biroz qimmatroq**, lekin sifati yaxshiroq.

sentences.text: Can you speak **a little louder**? The people at the back can't hear you.
sentences.translation: **Sal balandroq** gapira olasizmi? Orqadagilar sizni eshitmayapti.

sentences.text: Today is **slightly warmer** than yesterday, so we can eat outside.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechagidan **sal iliqroq**, tashqarida ovqatlansak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Prices in the supermarket are **a little higher** than at the bazaar.
sentences.translation: Supermarketdagi narxlar bozordagidan **biroz balandroq**.

sentences.text: I'd prefer a **slightly bigger** room, if you have one.
sentences.translation: Agar bor bo'lsa, **biroz kattaroq** xonani afzal ko'rardim.

sentences.text: Our flight was **a bit shorter** than usual because of the strong tailwind.
sentences.translation: Kuchli orqa shamol tufayli parvozimiz odatdagidan **sal qisqaroq** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Aziz's results were **slightly worse** this term, so his parents were worried.
sentences.translation: Bu chorakda Azizning natijalari **biroz yomonroq** bo'ldi, shuning uchun ota-onasi xavotirlandi.

sentences.text: Could you walk **a little more slowly**? My feet are killing me.
sentences.translation: **Sal sekinroq** yura olasizmi? Oyoqlarim qattiq og'riyapti.

sentences.text: The second interview went **a bit better**, and James finally got the job.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi suhbat **sal yaxshiroq** o'tdi va Jeyms nihoyat ishga qabul qilindi.

examples.title: With nouns: **many more** people, **much more** time
examples.description: **much more** + sanalmaydigan ot, **many more** + ko'plik ot; **far more / a lot more** — ikkalasi bilan; **a few more**, **far fewer**.

sentences.text: We need **much more** time to finish this project properly.
sentences.translation: Bu loyihani yaxshilab tugatish uchun bizga **ancha ko'p** vaqt kerak.

sentences.text: **Many more** tourists visit Khiva now than ten years ago.
sentences.translation: Hozir Xivaga o'n yil oldingiga qaraganda **ancha ko'p** sayyoh keladi.

sentences.text: There's **far more** traffic in the city centre on Fridays.
sentences.translation: Juma kunlari shahar markazida tirbandlik **ancha ko'p** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Can I have **a little more** sugar in my tea, please?
sentences.translation: Choyimga **yana ozgina** shakar solsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Only **a few more** guests are coming, so we have enough chairs.
sentences.translation: Yana **bir nechta** mehmon keladi, xolos, shuning uchun stullar yetarli.

sentences.text: The company hired **many more** engineers after it won the contract.
sentences.translation: Shartnomani yutib olgach, kompaniya **ancha ko'p** muhandis yolladi.

sentences.text: Nowadays young people spend **far more** money on online shopping.
sentences.translation: Hozirgi yoshlar onlayn xaridga **ancha ko'p** pul sarflaydi.

sentences.text: Jasur has read **a lot more** books this year than last year.
sentences.translation: Jasur bu yil o'tgan yilgiga qaraganda **ancha ko'p** kitob o'qidi.

sentences.text: There were **far fewer** applicants for the job than the manager had hoped.
sentences.translation: Ishga ariza berganlar rahbar umid qilganidan **ancha kam** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Doctors recommend eating **much less** salt and **a lot more** vegetables.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar **ancha kam** tuz va **ancha ko'p** sabzavot iste'mol qilishni tavsiya qiladi.

examples.title: Questions and negatives: **any better**, **no cheaper**
examples.description: Savol va inkorda **any** + qiyosiy («sal», «sira»); **no** + qiyosiy = not any + qiyosiy.

sentences.text: Is your knee **any better** today, or does it still hurt?
sentences.translation: Bugun tizzangiz **sal tuzukmi** yoki hali ham og'riyaptimi?

sentences.text: I'm exhausted, so I can't walk **any further**.
sentences.translation: Holdan toydim, **bundan nariga** yura olmayman.

sentences.text: The new version of the software isn't **any faster** than the old one.
sentences.translation: Dasturning yangi versiyasi eskisidan **sira tez emas**.

sentences.text: We can't wait **any longer**, so we'll start the meeting without Tom.
sentences.translation: **Ortiq** kuta olmaymiz, shuning uchun yig'ilishni Tomsiz boshlaymiz.

sentences.text: Business class was **no more comfortable** than economy on that airline.
sentences.translation: O'sha aviakompaniyada biznes-klass ekonomdan **sira qulay emas** edi.

sentences.text: Was the second hotel **any cheaper** than the first?
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi mehmonxona birinchisidan **arzonroq** edimi?

sentences.text: Believe me, the traffic is **no better** at night.
sentences.translation: Ishoning, kechasi ham tirbandlik **bundan yaxshi emas**.

sentences.text: Madina's flat is **no bigger** than a hotel room, but she loves it.
sentences.translation: Madinaning kvartirasi mehmonxona xonasidan **katta emas**, lekin u uni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: If the pain doesn't get **any better** by Monday, see a doctor.
sentences.translation: Agar dushanbagacha og'riq **sal ham kamaymasa**, shifokorga boring.

sentences.text: According to the news, life in the region isn't getting **any easier**.
sentences.translation: Yangiliklarga ko'ra, mintaqada hayot **sira yengillashmayapti**.

examples.title: Continuous change: **better and better**, **more and more**
examples.description: Uzluksiz o'zgarish: qiyosiy daraja **and** bilan takrorlanadi; uzun sifatda — **more and more** + sifat. O'zbekchada «tobora».

sentences.text: Your English is getting **better and better** — you hardly make mistakes now.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilingiz **tobora yaxshilanib** boryapti — endi deyarli xato qilmaysiz.

sentences.text: In July the days got **hotter and hotter**, and nobody wanted to go out.
sentences.translation: Iyulda kunlar **tobora isib** bordi, hech kim tashqariga chiqqisi kelmasdi.

sentences.text: Flights to Europe are becoming **more and more expensive**.
sentences.translation: Yevropaga parvozlar **tobora qimmatlashib** boryapti.

sentences.text: **More and more** families in Tashkent are buying electric cars.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda **tobora ko'proq** oila elektromobil sotib olyapti.

sentences.text: The queue outside the embassy was getting **longer and longer**.
sentences.translation: Elchixona oldidagi navbat **tobora uzayib** borardi.

sentences.text: Since the new manager arrived, Oliver has been **less and less** interested in his job.
sentences.translation: Yangi rahbar kelganidan beri Oliver ishiga **tobora kamroq** qiziqyapti.

sentences.text: The film got **worse and worse**, so we left before the end.
sentences.translation: Film **tobora yomonlashib** bordi, shuning uchun oxirigacha ko'rmay chiqib ketdik.

sentences.text: It's becoming **more and more difficult** to find a cheap flat near the university.
sentences.translation: Universitet yaqinidan arzon kvartira topish **tobora qiyinlashib** boryapti.

sentences.text: With every presentation, Nilufar sounded **more and more confident**.
sentences.translation: Har bir taqdimot bilan Nilufar **tobora ishonchliroq** gapirardi.

sentences.text: Smartphones get **thinner and thinner**, but their batteries don't last any longer.
sentences.translation: Smartfonlar **tobora yupqalashib** boryapti, lekin batareyalari sira uzoqroq chidamayapti.

examples.title: **The more** you practise, **the better** you get
examples.description: Ikki bog'liq o'zgarish: **the** + qiyosiy ..., **the** + qiyosiy ... — «qanchalik ...-sa, shunchalik ...».

sentences.text: **The more** you practise, **the better** your pronunciation becomes.
sentences.translation: **Qanchalik ko'p** mashq qilsangiz, talaffuzingiz **shunchalik yaxshilanadi**.

sentences.text: My grandfather says that **the older** he gets, **the more** he misses his village.
sentences.translation: Bobomning aytishicha, **yoshi ulg'aygan sari** qishlog'ini **ko'proq** sog'inar ekan.

sentences.text: At the airport, **the longer** we waited, **the angrier** the passengers became.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda **qancha uzoq** kutsak, yo'lovchilar **shuncha ko'proq asabiylashardi**.

sentences.text: **The earlier** you book, **the cheaper** the tickets are.
sentences.translation: **Qanchalik erta** band qilsangiz, chiptalar **shunchalik arzon** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Before the exam, **the harder** Bekzod studied, **the calmer** he felt.
sentences.translation: Imtihon oldidan Bekzod **qanchalik ko'p** o'qisa, o'zini **shunchalik xotirjam** his qilardi.

sentences.text: Remember that **the faster** you drive, **the more** fuel you use.
sentences.translation: Esda tuting: **qanchalik tez** haydasangiz, **shunchalik ko'p** yoqilg'i sarflaysiz.

sentences.text: Is it true that **the more** you sleep, **the healthier** you are?
sentences.translation: **Qanchalik ko'p** uxlasangiz, **shunchalik sog'lom** bo'lishingiz rostmi?

sentences.text: Strangely, **the more** I read about politics, **the less** I understand it.
sentences.translation: G'alati, siyosat haqida **qancha ko'p** o'qisam, uni **shuncha kam** tushunaman.

sentences.text: In summer, **the hotter** it gets, **the more crowded** the lakes near Tashkent become.
sentences.translation: Yozda havo **qanchalik isisa**, Toshkent yaqinidagi ko'llar **shunchalik gavjum** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: According to my boss, **the simpler** the slides are, **the clearer** the message is.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'imning aytishicha, slaydlar **qanchalik sodda** bo'lsa, fikr **shunchalik aniq** yetadi.

examples.title: **The more money** ... / **The sooner, the better**
examples.description: Ot bilan (the more money ..., the more tax ...) va fe'lsiz qisqa shakllar: **the sooner, the better**, **the more, the merrier**.

sentences.text: **The more** money you earn, **the more** tax you pay.
sentences.translation: **Qancha ko'p** pul topsangiz, **shuncha ko'p** soliq to'laysiz.

sentences.text: When can you start? — **The sooner, the better**.
sentences.translation: Qachon boshlay olasiz? — **Qanchalik tez bo'lsa, shuncha yaxshi**.

sentences.text: Which size of pizza should we order? — **The bigger, the better**!
sentences.translation: Qaysi o'lchamdagi pitsa buyuramiz? — **Qanchalik katta bo'lsa, shuncha yaxshi**!

sentences.text: You can bring your friends to the party — **the more, the merrier**.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga do'stlaringni ham olib kel — **qancha ko'p bo'lsak, shuncha qiziq**.

sentences.text: In this job, **the more** experience you have, **the higher** your salary will be.
sentences.translation: Bu ishda tajribangiz **qanchalik ko'p** bo'lsa, maoshingiz **shunchalik yuqori** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Teachers say that **the more** books children read, **the richer** their vocabulary becomes.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchilarning aytishicha, bolalar **qancha ko'p** kitob o'qisa, so'z boyligi **shuncha boyiydi**.

sentences.text: On social media, **the more** followers you have, **the more** adverts companies offer you.
sentences.translation: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda obunachilaringiz **qancha ko'p** bo'lsa, kompaniyalar sizga **shuncha ko'p** reklama taklif qiladi.

sentences.text: **The fewer** people know about the surprise, **the better**.
sentences.translation: Syurpriz haqida **qanchalik kam** odam bilsa, **shunchalik yaxshi**.

sentences.text: Why do you need a deadline? — Because **the less** time I have, **the faster** I work.
sentences.translation: Nega sizga muddat kerak? — Chunki vaqtim **qanchalik kam** bo'lsa, **shunchalik tez** ishlayman.

sentences.text: Should we leave at six? — Yes, **the earlier, the better**, because the roads will still be empty.
sentences.translation: Soat oltida chiqaylikmi? — Ha, **qanchalik erta bo'lsa, shuncha yaxshi**, chunki yo'llar hali bo'sh bo'ladi.

examples.title: Dialogue: recovering from a knee injury
examples.description: Ikki do'st jarohatdan keyingi tuzalish haqida gaplashadi: **any better**, **much better**, **a bit more slowly**, **stronger and stronger**, **the longer ..., the safer ...**.

sentences.text: — Hi, Oliver! How's your knee? Is it **any better** this week?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Oliver! Tizzang qalay? Bu hafta **sal tuzukmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, thanks, it's **much better**, but it still hurts on the stairs.
sentences.translation: — Ha, rahmat, **ancha yaxshi**, lekin zinada hali ham og'riydi.

sentences.text: — Are you doing your exercises? **The more** you do them, **the faster** it'll heal.
sentences.translation: — Mashqlaringni qilyapsanmi? **Qanchalik ko'p** qilsang, **shunchalik tez** tuzaladi.

sentences.text: — Every morning. And I can walk **a lot further** than last week.
sentences.translation: — Har kuni ertalab. O'tgan haftaga qaraganda **ancha uzoqroq** yura olaman.

sentences.text: — That's great! Can you run yet, or is that **far more** difficult?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Yugura olasanmi yoki bu **ancha qiyin**mi?

sentences.text: — Not yet. The doctor says I should move **a bit more slowly**.
sentences.translation: — Hali yo'q. Shifokor **sal sekinroq** harakat qilishim kerakligini aytdi.

sentences.text: — Sensible advice. My cousin hurried, and his knee got **worse and worse**.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri maslahat. Amakivachcham shoshilgan edi, tizzasi **tobora yomonlashib** ketdi.

sentences.text: — Don't worry, I'm being careful, and it's getting **stronger and stronger**.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olma, ehtiyot bo'lyapman, tizzam **tobora kuchayib** boryapti.

sentences.text: — So will you play next month? Without you, the team is **much weaker**.
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, kelasi oy o'ynaysanmi? Sensiz jamoa **ancha kuchsiz**.

sentences.text: — I hope so, but **the longer** I rest, **the safer** it is for my knee.
sentences.translation: — Umid qilaman, lekin **qanchalik uzoq** dam olsam, tizzam uchun **shunchalik xavfsiz**.
